author: Blizzard Entertainment
description:
Ahead of their upcoming U.S. tour, it’s going to be a “Perfect Night” when LE SSERAFIM returns to BlizzCon 2026! ✨


Join us in Anaheim September 12–13 as LE SSERAFIM celebrates BlizzCon weekend with the community before taking the Main Stage as the closing musical act on Sunday, September 13.


Learn more about LE SSERAFIM’s return to BlizzCon 2026 and what to expect this September: 
http://news.blizzard.com/article/24287692
title: LE SSERAFIM RETURNS TO BLIZZCON 2026!
